title: Palindrome Linked List - Solution
intuition: Given the head of a singly linked list, return true if it is a palindrome.
step_by_step_explanation: Iterate through elements and apply logic accordingly.
code:
def solution(head):
    if not head or not head.next:
        return True
    slow, fast = head, head
    while fast and fast.next:
        slow = slow.next
        fast = fast.next.next
    prev = None
    curr = slow
    while curr:
        nxt = curr.next
        curr.next = prev
        prev = curr
        curr = nxt
    p1, p2 = head, prev
    while p2:
        if p1.val != p2.val:
            return False
        p1 = p1.next
        p2 = p2.next
    return True
common_mistakes: Reverse the second half of the list.
